question: The Motihari-Amlekhgunj petroleum pipeline project is associated with India and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Motihari-Amlekhgunj Petroleum Product Pipeline (MAPL)** is a landmark project connecting **India** and **Nepal**, serving as **South Asia’s first cross-border petroleum products pipeline**.
 
• The pipeline was jointly inaugurated on **September 10, 2019**, by the Prime Minister of India, **Narendra Modi**, and the then Prime Minister of Nepal, **K.P. Sharma Oli**, via a video link.
 
• It spans a total distance of **69 kilometers**, starting from **Motihari** in the **East Champaran** district of **Bihar, India**, and terminating at **Amlekhgunj** in the **Bara** district of **Nepal**.
 
• The project was executed by the **Indian Oil Corporation (IOCL)** in collaboration with the **Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC)** to ensure a seamless supply of fuel.
